description:
The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} serves mocked usage and pricing. To "open the spend popup": navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}, then click the VISIBLE ".context-usage-label" element (a hidden one may exist too; pick the visible one). "The popup" is the ".chat-context-popup" element; "the table" is the element inside the popup with role "table" and accessible name "Spend by model". When a step says an element's text "matches" a regular expression, test the regular expression against the element's raw textContent in an eval that has "expect". Perform the steps in order. The spend popup keeps a tall breakdown above its toggle on a short (1280x720) desktop window.
1. Open the spend popup.
2. The popup's [data-testid="token-cost-total"] text contains "$11.98".
3. Wait (with an eval that has expect "true") until the popup's bottom edge (getBoundingClientRect().y + height) is at or above the top (y) of the visible ".context-usage-label": popup.y + popup.height - label.y <= 0.
4. Click the visible ".context-usage-label" again. The popup becomes hidden.

steps.expression: (() => { const popup = document.querySelector('.chat-context-popup'); const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('.context-usage-label')].find(el => el.checkVisibility()); if (!popup || !label) return 'missing'; const pr = popup.getBoundingClientRect(); const lr = label.getBoundingClientRect(); return String(pr.y + pr.height - lr.y <= 0); })()
